children: Saudi Arabia’s active commercial registrations for tourist accommodation facility management rose 29 per cent year-on-year to 20,560 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, according to the Ministry of Commerce, as reported by Saudi Gazette.
The number increased by 4,595 registrations from 15,965 recorded during the same period in 2025.
Makkah led the Kingdom’s regions with 8,075 active registrations, followed by Riyadh with 7,110 and Madinah with 1,988.
The Eastern Province ranked fourth with 1,456 registrations, followed by Asir.

title: ZAWYA: Saudi Arabia’s tourist accommodation registrations rise 29% in Q3 2026
